quantity: training roster asserted at run time
reason: the roster used to be derived as [c for c in available() if role=='train'], which depends on WHICH PARQUET FILES ARE ON DISK rather than on the data (H14/D-39). Stage 9 wrote Danenberg's table and silently turned a 5-cohort run into a 6-cohort one with nothing in the log
note: the list is pinned as a literal in s4_spatial.py and asserted, and the assertion is PRINTED IN THE REPORT, not just the log. Same pattern as gate 7 check 0

quantity: LOCO macro-F1 of arm `neigh` minus arm `cell`
reason: the whole question of the stage: does a cell's spatial neighbourhood improve cross-cohort transfer. `cell` is z_cell only and is RE-MEASURED INSIDE THIS RUN rather than read from Gate 6's report - the vocabulary is now 109 triples and the roster 7 cohorts, so Gate 6's 0.3901 is not comparable to anything produced here (same discipline as D-27's core-9 control and Gate 6 check 4)
note: scored over the reliable clusters with the stroma waiver honoured, 7 LOCO folds

quantity: LOCO macro-F1 of arm `neigh` minus arm `shuffle`
reason: THE CONTROL THE DESIGN NAMES BY NAME (files/05 4.8): 'the third must fall back toward the first. If shuffling does not hurt, the spatial gain is not spatial - it is leakage'. `shuffle` permutes each cell's neighbour list with another cell's FROM THE SAME IMAGE, so the neighbourhood is still real tissue from the same slide and only the CORRESPONDENCE is destroyed
note: permuting within the image and not across it matters: across images the control would also destroy slide identity and would then be testing two things at once. MUST NOT BE DROPPED for time - without it check 1's margin means nothing

reason: the second half of the same control. A shuffled neighbourhood should be worth roughly nothing, so `shuffle` should land near `cell`. If `shuffle` beats `cell` by as much as `neigh` does, the gain is coming from extra parameters or from image-level statistics, not from which cells are actually adjacent
note: reported as three numbers on one line so the ordering cell <= shuffle < neigh can be read directly

quantity: paired per-fold difference (neigh - cell) with a 95% CI and a paired test
reason: NO GATE IN THIS PROJECT HAS EVER BEEN SCORED WITH A CONFIDENCE INTERVAL (H9), and the one time the tests were run retrospectively they did not survive: Gate 6 check 4 PASSED its declared +0.02 with p = 0.460 and a CI four times the margin, all of it from a single fold (D-44). Declaring the interval as part of the rule is the cheapest possible fix and it costs no extra compute
note: 7 folds instead of 5 makes this less underpowered than every earlier gate, but it is still n=7 - report the interval and the per-fold table, and do NOT write 'spatial context improves transfer' if the interval spans zero, whatever the mean says

quantity: LOCO macro-F1 of arm `ctx` minus arm `neigh`
reason: the neighbourhood-context auxiliary loss predicts the pooled neighbourhood profile from z_cell alone. It could not be written before this stage existed (D-40), which is why gate6_expect.csv records the declared '2 vs 4 losses' ablation as having been RUN AS A 2 vs 3. This makes it a real 2 vs 4 for the first time
note: required=0: it is an extra loss, not the stage. If the week runs short this is the FIRST arm to drop

quantity: verdict of check 1 under UPMC px_um scaled by 1.3 and by 0.77
reason: M4: UPMC's px_um is recorded as 'ASSUMED - not published anywhere; same CODEX vendor stack as CRC'. Stage 4 is the ONLY stage that ever uses physical distance, so an assumption that was harmless everywhere else becomes load-bearing here
note: the edge vector already carries d_rel = d / (image median nearest-neighbour distance), which is invariant to a wrong global scale. This check proves that rather than asserting it. 2 extra fits on the UPMC fold only

quantity: every neighbour shares its cell's image_id
reason: all coordinate frames are image-local (files/02 2.2) and CRC's are tile-local. A kNN built across images would join cells that are not neighbours at all and would silently manufacture a spatial signal
note: asserted at build time, per cohort, on every edge

reason: measured before the build: mean inter-cell spacing is 11.0-20.0 um across the 7 cohorts. A median edge far outside that range means the graph was built on the 40k SUBSAMPLE instead of the full raw table - which would put the median near 79 um for UPMC and would be the single easiest way to get this stage silently wrong
note: the sidecar is built from work/raw/*.parquet (every cell) and indexed back to the 40k target cells. This assert is what proves that happened

quantity: arm `shuffle` inputs are not bit-identical to arm `neigh`
reason: GATE 6 CHECK 6 PRINTED A REAL-LOOKING 0.0000 BECAUSE ITS TWO ARMS WERE SECRETLY THE SAME COMPUTATION (D-45) - confidence-on vs confidence-off was tested on the one fold where the only cohort with a confidence was held out. A check whose two arms could be identical must assert that they are not
note: cheap and general. Also assert the permutation is a genuine derangement on at least 99% of cells - a permutation that happens to be near-identity would be the same failure wearing a different hat
